description: This Java class defines a command for retrieving a policy by its ID within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON strings or objects, and manages policy identifiers as its primary data.

classes.name: RetrievePolicy
classes.description: An immutable command class that retrieves a policy by its unique ID within the Ditto framework, capable of serialization and deserialization from JSON.

methods.name: RetrievePolicy.of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrievePolicy with specified PolicyId and optional headers.

methods.name: RetrievePolicy.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrievePolicy object from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: RetrievePolicy.getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: RetrievePolicy.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrievePolicy with updated DittoHeaders.
